description: sheets.spreadsheets.values.append: POST v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}:append. Appends values to a spreadsheet. The input range is used to search for existing data and find a "table" within that range. Values will be appended to the next row of the table, starting with the first column of the table. See the guide and sample code for specific details of how tables are detected and data is appended. The caller must specify the spreadsheet ID, range, and a valueInputOption. Body: vendor ValueRange JSON, checked against the pinned discovery schema. Runs as a background job; completion preserves the vendor response and names the selected account. key, access_token and oauth_token are refused: the connected account authenticates. Parameters use exact vendor names. See editors_api_coverage.md for scopes, bodies and lifecycle.
embedding_description: Use Sheets Spreadsheets Values Append to appends values to a spreadsheet in Google Sheets, as the selected connected Google account (POST v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}:append). Send the vendor ValueRange body; it is checked against Google's schema. Returns Google's full response.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued; completion includes account, method, full vendor response and response headers.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Show the account that answered and the identifiers the caller needs next.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return one short message through the active IO plugin.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params names the argument or body field and the vendor rule it broke, including refused key/access_token/oauth_token; gsuite.unknown_account names connected accounts; gsuite.missing_scope requires reconnect; gsuite.auth_expired includes Testing-mode renewal guidance; gsuite.permission_denied, gsuite.not_found and gsuite.rate_limited preserve vendor messages.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Correct the named vendor field, choose a connected account, or reconnect with start_interface and connect_account to approve missing scopes. Retry rate limits later.
